description: This Java class 'Parameters' encapsulates the configuration and supported elements (operators, functions, constants, brackets, translations) for an expression evaluator library. It manages collections of these elements and provides methods to modify and retrieve them, supporting customization such as localization of function and constant names.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Represents the configurable parameters of an expression evaluator, including operators, functions, constants, bracket pairs, and translations.

methods.name: Parameters
methods.description: Constructor initializing empty lists/maps for parameters and setting default function argument separator to ','.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns the collection of supported operators.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns the collection of supported functions.

methods.name: getConstants
methods.description: Returns the collection of supported constants.

methods.name: getExpressionBrackets
methods.description: Returns the collection of bracket pairs used for expressions.

methods.name: getFunctionBrackets
methods.description: Returns the collection of bracket pairs used for functions.

methods.name: addOperators
methods.description: Adds a collection of operators to the supported operators.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single operator to the supported operators.

methods.name: addFunctions
methods.description: Adds a collection of functions to the supported functions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single function to the supported functions.

methods.name: addConstants
methods.description: Adds a collection of constants to the supported constants.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single constant to the supported constants.

methods.name: addExpressionBracket

methods.name: addFunctionBracket

methods.name: setTranslation
methods.description: Sets the translated name for a given function.

methods.name: setTranslation
methods.description: Sets the translated name for a given constant.

methods.name: getTranslation

methods.name: setFunctionArgumentSeparator

methods.name: getFunctionArgumentSeparator
methods.description: Retrieves the current function argument separator.
